item.title: Eyesore, 20th August
item.description:
The new build flats are running over a year behind schedule. The whole site is a dump (perhaps the builders have run out of money). The pavement outside the build is broken up and there are large clumps of weeds outside the site. For somewhere in this postcode it is a disgrace and by the looks of it, it will be at least another six months before it is ready. A neighbour is trying to sell her place but prospective buyers are put off by the dump at the end of the road
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Bromley Road, Shortlands, Greater London
